title: HEDIS Core Immunization
description: The HEDIS Core Immunization profile extends the US Core requirements to include requirements for measure calculation.

element.definition: [HEDIS] The metadata about a resource. This is content in the resource that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.
[US Core] Indicates the current status of the immunization event.
[US Core] Indicates the reason the immunization event was not performed.
[US Core] Vaccine that was administered or was to be administered.
[HEDIS] [US Core] The patient who either received or did not receive the immunization.
[HEDIS][US Core] Date vaccine administered or was to be administered.
element.comment: Strings are excluded from this element , it would not be use for calculating estimated or actual date.

element.definition: [US Core] An indication that the content of the record is based on information from the person who administered the vaccine. This reflects the context under which the data was originally recorded.
